# When the archsimd CPU feature check is false the array-operator
# vector form must take the scalar successor. Values cannot tell the
# paths apart (both are exact), so this leg runs the binary under a CPU
# without AVX: the false branch survives there, while a vector branch
# taken by mistake dies with SIGILL.
[!exec:qemu-x86_64] skip 'qemu-x86_64 is required for the no-AVX leg'
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'the no-AVX qemu leg needs an amd64 binary'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOAMD64=v1

cd m
logos build -o $WORK/add$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/add$GOEXE
stdout '^sums ok$'
exec qemu-x86_64 -cpu Nehalem $WORK/add$GOEXE
stdout '^avx2 false$'
stdout '^sums ok$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/gatenoavxqemu

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"simd/archsimd"
)

//go:noinline
func addI32x8(a, b [8]int32) [8]int32 { return a + b }

func oracleAdd(a, b [8]int32) [8]int32 {
	var r [8]int32
	for i := range a {
		r[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
	return r
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("avx2", archsimd.X86.AVX2())
	var a, b [8]int32
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = int32(i*7 - 100)
		b[i] = int32(i*3 + 1)
	}
	if addI32x8(a, b) != oracleAdd(a, b) {
		panic("int32 add mismatch")
	}
	fmt.Println("sums ok")
}
